ns2:course.label: LTI Main Stage
ns2:course.description: Portrayal of a named role in a Main Stage Lyric Theatre Illinois production. Culminates in public performances of sung theatre, developing and demonstrating skills in singing, acting, and movement. Rigorous rehearsal schedule. 1 to 2 undergraduate hours. 1 to 2 graduate hours. May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: Audition required and/or consent of instructor.
